passive.name: Fury of the Xer'Sai
passive.description: Rek'Sai generates Fury by Attacking and hitting with basic Abilities. She consumes this Fury while Burrowed to restore health.

spells.name: Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker
spells.description: Unburrowed: Rek'Sai's next 3 Attacks within seconds gain % Attack Speed and deal an additional physical damage to nearby enemies. Attacks refresh the duration of this Ability.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamageTooltip was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Burrow / Un-burrow
spells.description: Unburrowed: Rek'Sai burrows into the ground, gaining access to new Abilities but cannot Attack. She gains Move Speed, % reduced vision range, and nearby enemies that move and are otherwise unseen will have their positions revealed to Rek'sai and her allies.
spells.coverageNote: No champion damage packet is present for this cast.

spells.name: Furious Bite / Tunnel
spells.description: Unburrowed: Rek'Sai bites a target, dealing physical damage. At max Fury, the bite deals true damage instead.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation BaseDamageCalculation was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Void Rush
spells.description: Rek'Sai targets an enemy damaged by her in the last seconds and then dives underground, becoming Untargetable. Moments later, she leaps unstoppably at her target, dealing plus % max Health physical damage and resets the cooldown of Burrow / Un-burrow.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation RBaseDamageCalc was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.
